newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybean deliveries seen light to nil Thursday.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybean deliveries seen light to nil Thursday.

text.p: Delivery notices against the August Chicago Board of Trade soybean contract were expected to total 500,000 bushels or less on Thursday, first notice day for deliveries, traders said.
"There will be token or no beans, several thousand oil and no meal," a cash-connected trader said.
Thursday is the first day for delivery notices to be posted on the CBOT August contracts.
The tight supply of soybeans was expected to keep the delivery tally to a minimum and the CBOT late Monday reported a drop in the amount of soy registered for potential delivery.
The CBOT registrations report as of 1000 CDT Wednesday showed soybean registrations in Chicago at 965,000 bushels, St Louis 45,000 and Toledo 45,000 bushels.
Soyoil registrations totalled 7,766 lots and there was no soymeal registered for possible delivery.
Registration of a commmodity with the CBOT means that commodity is poised for a possible delivery posting against a CBOT contract.
Traders said that no soymeal was expected to be posted for delivery on the August contract and roughly 2,000 lots of soyoil were expected to be posted.
